body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves `plugin-form` modal responsiveness by auto-upgrading `ModalForm` dialog width when auto-layout results in multi-column forms, ensuring the intended grid layout can actually render within the modal container.

**Changes:**
- Added `inferModalSize(columns)` to map inferred columns to an appropriate modal width (`2→lg`, `3→xl`, `4+→full`).
- Updated `ModalForm` to compute auto-layout early and derive an `effectiveModalSize` when `schema.modalSize` is not explicitly set.
- Exported `inferModalSize` and added unit tests for it; updated the roadmap entry.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx | Re-exports `inferModalSize` from `autoLayout`. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts | Adds `inferModalSize(columns)` helper with documented mapping. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/autoLayout.test.ts | Adds unit tests for `inferModalSize`. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx | Memoizes auto-layout result and computes `effectiveModalSize` to widen modals for multi-column forms. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the modal-size auto-upgrade item as completed. |
</details>

The new auto-upgrade behavior for modal size (based on inferred columns) isn’t covered by an integration test. There are already ModalForm auto-layout integration tests in the repo; consider adding assertions that `DialogContent` receives the expected width class when columns are inferred (and that an explicitly provided `modalSize` still wins). This would also catch regressions for `customFields` vs schema-generated fields.
